reason: I already have a Brita bottle that does the job fine, including on trips. Paying $68 up front plus a filter subscription to swap one filtered bottle for another isn't worth it to me.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, from a brand I've never heard of, to replace a bottle I'm already happy with.
would_change_my_mind: If my current bottle broke and Claro let me buy the bottle plus filters one-off at around $35 with no subscription and free shipping, I might try it.
